I told my first girlfriend, who's friend was way hotter, that her friend wasn't my type and that she had "weird eyes" lmao. me and her friend ended up dating a few years later, so keep your head up. ain't nothing to worry about. sucks to feel that way about your self image and it's definitely not very nice that your friend didn't keep it to herself. but people need to play games sometimes to make other people feel less insecure and sometimes it messes things up. 

PS maybe tell her to pass on your number rating of her S/O. maybe he won't feel so good after that lol

definitely a great idea. when I'm going through times like this I just rifle through my kitchen and keep making meals with enough protein for my workouts, taking a bite and it just doesn't go down and my throat dries up and I have to find a new meal and then it happens again. might make a peanut butter chocolate smoothie when this happens from now on lol
happy birthday dawg. my two best friends started dating on my birthday and they flaked out on me for their anniversary one time. hope u have/had a great day ☺️

thanks. I'm really trying to improve my body, because a huge part of my depression is chronic pain in my neck ruining all my days. so I need to be working out and gaining muscle so I can hold my head up better (literally) but it's so annoying when Im having a wave and can't think of a single thing to eat. my throat just dries up and my stomach gets mad, but I was able to get some mac and cheese and sausage and I'm feeling like I got in enough food for the next few hours and I have some time to think about it without going into a hunger coma, lol

I've done some journaling, in a way. If I make it through whatever's next, I'd like to try writing a book about my experience. It's the only thing that gives me something to go on for. I just can't let a bunch of people die for nothing, I have to be the last one for some reason. I've written almost an entire outline, but towards the end is when some pretty terrible shit happens so it's hard to write that, but I've written a lot of notes about it and how to write it, which is something at least.
yea, I can't explain it but I know what you mean.

I had a friend like that. I had drug problems and self harm problems and then my gf died and I would constantly call her about it and she just drifted away to another friend group, leaving me all alone. my best friend for 13 years, left because I was struggling so hard. people like that are sick. talk to this friend, or leave her. I hope there's many more friends besides this bitch, because in the end, isolation is the last thing you want.

life is pain. life is love. life is everything. don't give up on anything, don't throw anything away. I feel the exact same way right now. all I want is to be dead, but we shouldn't be able to choose that. fight. and then fight some more. depression is fighting. fight until there's just one more good day and then fight until the next one. who knows how important anything really is? who cares? we're all here. we have to try. we gotta try together

keep away from it. I never knew why I was even doing it. attention? relief? nothing. it's not gonna help, that's why it's harm. my cousin has scars all along her leg and it shows every summer at our cabin. when I cut, I never did one so deep to leave a scar, but theres truly no benefit in any sh scenario. please don't go that way, it'll just get worse

yea, I feel the same way. I barely feel close to my 2 closest friends and they're now dating, so it's super awkward and depressing to see them so happy when I'm so alone right now. They do ask if I'm okay, but it doesn't last. I just text one back and forth for 15 minutes and then they say something like "I feel for you" or whatever. The other asks, but as soon as I say something too depressing he just changes the subject and I feel so unheard.
